note: Rates fixed by law rather than by HSN. Add a new row with its effective date when a notification changes one; never edit or remove a past row - invoices already issued were taxed by it.

EWB_CONSIGNMENT_THRESHOLD.note: Rupees. Consignment value = value under s.15 plus tax charged, excluding exempt supplies. Some states set a higher limit for movement within the state; this is the inter-state limit.

EINVOICE_30_DAY_LIMIT_AATO.note: Rupees of annual aggregate turnover. At or above it, the IRP refuses an invoice or note dated more than 30 days before it is reported.
EINVOICE_30_DAY_LIMIT_AATO.source: GSTN advisory, 13-09-2023 (AATO of Rs 100 crore and above)

EINVOICE_30_DAY_LIMIT_AATO.note: Extended to AATO of Rs 10 crore and above.
